typography.strategy: The 'Editorial Future' tailored for Esports. A wide, aggressive Display font for headings and numbers, paired with a highly legible Geometric Sans for UI elements and questions.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans.
Numbers in score/streak/timer MUST use Unbounded for a gaming feel.
Do NOT use pure #000000. Use Void Black (#050505).
Do NOT use generic Vercel gradients. Rely on sharp neon accents on dark backgrounds.
Always set text color on hover. When hovering an accent background, text must switch to inverse (black).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look) mixed with Retro-Futurism for the AI Quiz mode.
effects: Add a subtle CSS noise/grain overlay (`bg-[url('/noise.png')] opacity-20 pointer-events-none`) over the main background to eliminate digital flatness.
Active state cards must have a 1px solid primary color border with a subtle inner glow (`shadow-[inset_0_0_15px_rgba(228,255,0,0.15)]`).
Glassmorphism ONLY for sticky headers or modals (`bg-[#0F0F11]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10`).

grids_layouts.spacing_system: Use generous spacing. Tailwind p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders MUST have generous internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
grids_layouts.bento_grid: For the Dashboard/Profile, use 'The Tetris Grid'. Grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-8. Gap-6. Mix large stat cards with smaller detail blocks to create asymmetry.
grids_layouts.category_grid: Use grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Each category card should be tall (aspect-[3/4]) with an image overlay and large bold category name at the bottom.

components.buttons: Sharp edges or extremely pill-shaped. No in-between. Primary CTA is Cyber Yellow (#E4FF00) background with Black text. Font black. Hover: scale slightly, increase brightness. Add a subtle drop-shadow glowing effect.
components.inputs: Flat surfaces. bg-[#0F0F11], 1px border-[#27272A]. Focus: border-primary ring-1 ring-primary/50.
components.quiz_play_card: Center aligned question, huge text. 4 massive answer buttons. Unselected: surface_raised. Hover: 1px border primary. Selected (Correct): bg-success text-black. Selected (Wrong): bg-error text-white.
components.timer_ring: Use SVG circle with stroke-dasharray for the 15s timer. Color transitions from success (green) to warning (yellow) to error (red) as time runs out.
components.result_screen: Requires Confetti explosion (react-confetti). Massive score text in neon yellow. 'Share' button with copy-to-clipboard functionality.
components.leaderboard: Dense table layout. Rank 1, 2, 3 should have custom row backgrounds (gold/silver/bronze tints on dark bg). Sticky header for table.

motion.interactions: Hover states must scale (`scale-[1.02]`) and shift border colors instantly, while backgrounds transition smoothly.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in with a slight upward translation (`translate-y-4` to `translate-y-0`).
motion.staggered_lists: Leaderboard items and Category cards must animate in sequentially using framer-motion staggerChildren.
motion.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all scale and translate animations.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure black text over Neon Yellow/Cyan/Green backgrounds for WCAG AAA compliance.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus state: `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-black`.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="play-now-btn"`).

icons.usage: Use heavily in navigation, stat blocks (XP, Streak, Time), and categories. Color icons with neon accents against dark backgrounds.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use `react-confetti` for the result screen. Use `framer-motion` for UI elements. No heavy 3D canvas needed to keep the game fast, but utilize 3D-styled avatars (images) and heavy CSS shadows to simulate depth.

hero_backgrounds.description: Green and pink abstract art, excellent for AI Quiz hero or general abstract background with an overlay.
Abstract long exposure of orange and blue light streaks, gives a feeling of speed and data.

avatars.description: 3D cartoon character with a blue hat, use as default guest/player avatar.
3D cartoon character with purple hair and sunglasses.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `react-confetti` and `react-use` (for window size) using yarn for the results screen.
Configure Tailwind with the extended color palette (Electric & Neon) provided in this JSON.
Import 'Unbounded' and 'Outfit' fonts via Google Fonts in index.css.
Set the root background color to `#050505` and text to `#FFFFFF`.
Add a CSS grain texture over the main app wrapper: `pointer-events: none; background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml,...'); opacity: 0.05`.
Ensure the timer logic handles the 15-second countdown with a visual indicator (progress bar or SVG ring).
Use standard `.js` / `.jsx` extension since TypeScript is not enforced, but write clean React 18+ code.
Create the app following mobile-first layout principles, but ensure the Desktop esports UI is dense and heavily styled.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and neon drop-shadows instead of typical soft box-shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully. ONLY use it on headers or overlays, never on base cards.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like sharp or pill-shaped with interaction animations & high-contrast text.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects. Static = dead.
Use generous spacing. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g. data-testid='login-btn').
Missing categories (especially user avatars or category covers) MUST utilize the provided image_urls. NEVER use placeholder text/domains.
